column1: # Reviewed privileged-event jobs allowed on persistent runners (ADR 0235).
# path<TAB>job<TAB>review digest<TAB>justification. The digest covers the job, its
# inherited workflow env/permissions/defaults, and every calling job, so any edit
# turns the entry STALE until it is re-reviewed. Procedure: ADR 0235 decision 6.

column4: Runs only for merged PRs; sparse-checks out scripts/ci-gate/post-merge-reconcile.sh at pull_request.base.sha with persist-credentials false and executes only that script plus inline gh/jq; head SHA/ref/repo are API identifiers; the merge-attestation-<run> artifact must come from a successful default-branch ai-review-merge.yml workflow_dispatch run and attestation.json is schema-validated with jq as data

workflow_run of actions-ci: sparse-checks out only scripts/ci-gate/review-policy-envelope.py from Verjson/.github at job.workflow_sha (the executing default-branch revision) and executes only that decoder plus inline gh/jq; the triggering run's head SHA and PRs are API identifiers; the ai-review-arm receipt is read as data with jq and review_policy is regex-bounded before decoding

Remote callee app-key-environment.yml pinned to full SHA ebe23faf: at that SHA it has no uses: or checkout step and no PR-head reference; validate runs on ubuntu-24.04 and validate-ai-review-key checks the App key environment inline

No checkout or source-fetching action; executes only inline bash and heredoc-authored Python from the base workflow plus gh/jq API calls; PR head SHA and number are compared as data; ai-review-arm-<run>-<attempt> receipts come from trusted gate-rearm runs whose workflow blob is matched to the default branch, are downloaded to a mktemp directory, and are read only as data with jq; caller workflow blobs fetched through the git/blobs API are hashed, never executed
